newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain spread vs Bunds to decline to 125 bps - poll.
newsitem.headline: Spain spread vs Bunds to decline to 125 bps - poll.

text.p: The spread between Spanish and German 10-year bonds, which dipped to an all-time low of 131 basis points on Wednesday, could narrow further toward 125 or even 120 basis points before year-end, a Reuter poll showed.
A survey of 10 economists conducted on Wednesday showed a slight majority predicted a further decline in the long-term spread, while four forecast a widening back to 150 basis points.
The economists agreed the Dublin summit in mid-December was a key market factor, and said any progress on a stability pact could prompt further gains for Spanish bonds.
One analyst said the spread could widen to 170 bps if the summit is considered a failure, while success could push the spread in to 100 basis points.
